review_scope: Primary independently read all complete required core files: env.json, task.json, controls.json, generator, browser JavaScript, CSS, grader, verifier and solver, as well as the first-pass report. The shared verifier helper had already been read in full.
decision: Change visual to 2D and reasoning/planning to No. Every station card automatically lists the currently reachable spacecraft. Matching a listed craft to its screen marker is sufficient; on release or target-button click the browser computes the exact 3D aim vector itself. The solver need not infer the sphere-normal relation. Progress is accumulated independently for each craft and survives link breaks, so a general UI policy is to use any currently listed unfinished craft, let the link run, and repeat after a break. This requires no future handoff plan or tradeoff between deliveries. Keep temporal Yes provisionally for changing station coordinates in full mode and the limited validity of an aim before activation/refresh, and exploration No because availability and progress are automatically displayed.

rationale_clarifications.visual: 3D is implemented by the simulator but is not required of the visible-UI solver: the automatically updated station cards explicitly enumerate the correct station-to-craft relation and UI handlers compute aim vectors.
rationale_clarifications.reasoning_planning: No route, scarce resource, progress penalty or downstream dependency requires planning: each request's units survive link breaks, and the visible lookup supplies the next eligible pair. Re-aiming or retrying after routine feedback does not by itself establish reasoning/planning.
rationale_clarifications.temporal: Do not describe HOLD LINK as a minimum-duration physical hold. It is a latched button. Full-mode station markers move; in simplified mode a selected aim can become stale before the separate HOLD LINK action, so the current temporal Yes is provisional action-validity/timing evidence, not autonomous animation alone.
rationale_clarifications.exploration_interface: All station-to-craft availability is computed and displayed before any selection, and is refreshed automatically.

additional_source_evidence.claim: Station cards list all reachable craft; both input handlers compute exact 3D aiming automatically from the selected IDs.
Progress only increments, and a link break clears the active link without erasing delivered units.
Simplified aiming snapshots a vector before a separate hold action; later sampling can reject its changing angular error.

uncertainties: Source-only classification. Temporal labels, especially the latched simplified interface, remain provisional pending the separately deferred configuration-wide temporal audit. No real-time label assigned.
